questions.notes: Classifiers and role shifting are ASL grammatical/storytelling techniques — accept 'sign language interpreter', 'ASL interpreter', or 'signer'.

questions.text: What is the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit?
questions.notes: Accept 98.6°F (37°C), or a reasonable range around it (97–99°F).

questions.text: In a blood pressure reading like 120 over 80, what does the top number measure?
questions.answer: Systolic pressure — the pressure when the heart beats/contracts
questions.notes: Accept 'systolic' or a description like 'pressure when the heart squeezes/beats'. Bottom number is diastolic (heart at rest).
